points: \item Engineered AI-powered digital twins for clinical trial simulation, leveraging generative models to predict patient outcomes and optimize study design.
\item Developed robust causal inference frameworks to estimate treatment effects from observational data, directly supporting decision-making in drug development.
\item Collaborated with cross-functional teams to integrate machine learning solutions into clinical workflows, ensuring regulatory compliance and scientific rigor.
\item Implemented scalable data pipelines to process high-dimensional clinical datasets, ensuring data quality and readiness for advanced modeling.
\item Designed and executed rigorous validation studies for AI models, documenting performance metrics and failure modes to meet industry standards.
\item Conducted research on novel ML architectures for healthcare applications, contributing to the advancement of precision medicine and faster clinical trials.
